data.description:
## Incident Overview

### Expected Behavior
The fix-bug Worktree Ancestry Gate (Phase A Step 2.5) should pass when the bug was filed against code whose changes have landed on the current HEAD — regardless of which merge strategy was used (merge commit, squash, or rebase).

### Actual Behavior
The gate uses `git merge-base --is-ancestor <code_version> HEAD`, which only succeeds when the exact commit SHA appears in HEAD's ancestry. Under `merge.strategy=pr` with squash or rebase merges (the project default), the original worktree commit is discarded and replaced by a new commit on main — the original SHA never appears in main's history. Every bug filed from a worktree session subsequently fails the ancestry gate after that worktree merges, even though the affected code is present on HEAD.

### Reproduction
1. Create a worktree branch; commit SHA `X` containing a bug fix or affected file.
2. File a bug ticket from that worktree (`code_version: X` recorded in the description).
3. Squash-merge the worktree branch to main via merge-to-main.sh / `gh pr merge --squash`.
4. From a fresh worktree off the new main, run `/dso:fix-bug <ticket-id>`.
5. Ancestry gate emits FAILED — `git merge-base --is-ancestor X HEAD` returns false because `X` was discarded during squash.

### Impact
Observed on 2026-05-16: 1 of 8 user-requested batch fixes hit this; remaining 7 likely affected. Forces user to authorize per-batch bypass, defeating the gate's intent. Tickets that ARE genuinely stale (filed against reverted code) become indistinguishable from tickets that simply traversed a squash merge.

### Likely Fix Directions
- Treat the gate as advisory (warn) rather than hard-stop when merge strategy is squash/rebase.
- Cross-check via file-content presence: if the affected file path exists on HEAD AND a content fingerprint from code_version's blob is reachable, treat as ancestor.
- Use `git log --grep` against PR titles / ticket IDs in main's commit messages to detect squash-merged ancestry.
- Record the merge-commit SHA on the ticket at merge time and check that, not the pre-merge worktree SHA.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
- Skill: /dso:fix-bug Phase A Step 2.5 (Worktree Ancestry Gate)
- Script: plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md (gate logic inline)
- Config interaction: merge.strategy=pr (project default) is what triggers this
data.title: [fix-bug ancestry gate]: code_version SHA absent from HEAD after squash/rebase merge -> all bugs filed against merged worktrees fail ancestry gate
